reviews.x: This mascara really does lift and lengthen. I usually use 2 coats. First layer is to shape and lift and the second is to finish off the tips to make them stand out. Once it’s set, my eyelashes stay set until I wash the mascara off. Even though this mascara works like that, my eyelashes still stay soft and it washes off very easily. I only have one complaint. It feels like this mascara dries up very quickly. They say you should replace your mascara every 3 months and I find that I’m replacing thi

reviews.t: The only mascara that doesn’t cause my eyes to burn!
reviews.x: I hardly write reviews, but I feel like I can help others who have mascara issues. The past 5 years, I have not been able to find a mascara that is non irritating and still lengthens. Yes, it lengthens, does not clump, is is ophthalmologist approved. I have been a mascara addict before I developed an irritation to all mascaras except this one. For the price too don’t look any further! I have always bought the most expensive mascaras: Tarte, Lancome etc. I am the happiest woman right now bc I can

Meh. This mascara is thick and dries up in the tube well before the normal mascaras. I like thick mascaras but this is nearly a bit gloppy. Tried it for 2 or 3 tubes worth thinking it might have just been old stock. Also ends up under my eyes by 11 am. No thanks, all done now.

reviews.t: Woah, I have eye lashes! also, does not irritate my sensitive eyes
reviews.x: I'm pleasantly surprised by this Almay Length & Lift mascara. My litmus test to a good mascara has been reduced to simply whether it irritates my eyes or not. As for lengthening, lifting, volumizing, etc is meaningless in comparison. This DOES NOT IRRITATE (!!) YAY!!! Also, the blackest black is wonderfully black; makes my brown eyes pop. My lashes are well coated, making them look thicker, and there is a lift that I greatly appreciate as my lashes otherwise angle downward. Length is notable too

This is the worst mascara I have ever used. It clumps and makes a total mess. I suspect the collar inside the tube is not tight enough to take off the excess as you remove it. Even after I try to take the excess off the wand by scraping it against the top of the tube (as recommended by makeup artists) it clumps. Only way I can use it is to then wipe the brush to remove most of the mascara! I will not be purchasing again.
Bought this product hoping it would not "bother my eyes". Very happy I purchased. My eyes don't itch, no longer want to rub my eyes. Easy to use!

Almay Length & Lift Mascara was a HUGE, pleasant surprise.  I've used only Lacome Mascara for 20+ years. Over those years it has gotten pricey ($30 now), however, I loved the product and bought it anyway.  Over the last few years, Lacome's quality has slipped, even received a couple of tubes that seemed 'used'. This mascara literally glides on, and really does what it says, it 'lengthens and lifts'. Another great feature is that it's so easy to remove.  Price is super reasonable.  Can't recommen
This mascara DOES NOT bother my eyes.  I have issues with most mascara. I finally found one that woks and is great without itching eyes. Try it!!

I rate this a 10/10 for dry or sensitive eyes. I have extremely dry/painful eyes and this is the only mascara I’ve been able to tolerate. This mascara is so light and gentle that my eyes actually feel bare and I forget I’m wearing any eye makeup at all!  Pros: - No crumbles, clumps, or flakes - Shiny, smooth, gel-like appearance - Comfortable and non-irritating - Very natural looking  Cons: - No noticeable lift or curl - Doesn’t add very much length - Smudges easily  Overall, I think this mascar

I've tried over 30 major brands of mascara, high end, luxury, target, Walmart, indie brands, even all natural brands and all of them burned my eyes like fire. THIS mascara is about 95% irritant free and when it does bother me it's extremely minimal.  I am so happy I found this!
I have developed a sensitivity to my usual mascara. I been using this Almay for about two weeks and no more tears and burning. It’s light but covers well. Very pleased.
Love Almay  products which are truly hypoallergenic.  Made my lashes long and only needed one coat.

I have always loved and used Almay. I use to wear false eyelashes to make my eyelashes longer. Got fed up with applying them and taking them off. Yes I got lazy. I have short eyelashes.... Tried different types of Almay mascara and have to say this one is a "WINNER" for me. No irritation, no smell, no flaking and only takes about 2 coats to get the look I am wanting. :) Am going to be buying another one just because I like the price and it's perfect for me. Thanks Almay!

I purchased this mascara because I have very sensitive eyes, and I needed to replace the Clinique mascara I had that isn't sold any longer. This mascara has not caused any sensitivity or infections. However, it clumps excessively, despite trying to remove the excess from the wand when taking it out. It is also difficult to remove after wearing, even with a high quality makeup remover. I've used it about 5 or 6 times now, and it's heading to the trash can now.

Almay products have been very reliable for me for sensitivity issues. I am not a make up pro by no means, however this works well for my tastes. Applies easily and stays but. We are having very mild weather at the moment so I am curious about it’s staying power through higher temperatures and heavier humidity. My lashes are thin so this does effectively help to make my lashes appear fuller and darker without clumping. Pleased so far with this product.

I usually love Almay products but this mascara is horrible.  The brush comes out just overly coated in mascara and has no separation to the brush.  I tried it a second time thinking I could just really scrape the brush on the opening.  I swiped it 5 times and it is still is horrible.  I can actually see my upper eyelashes in my line of sight.  Going into the trash.

Extends, lifts & nourishes lashes. Gentle, buildable formula intensifies & defines lashes with a brush that is made from 100% plant-derived bristles. It's formulated with plant-based waxes & conditioners to nourish lashes. No clumping, flaking or smudging. Hypoallergenic, Opthamologist tested, suitable for sensitive eyes & contact lens wearers, fragrance-free.

reviews.t: Still makes my eye lids itch
reviews.x: At first, it was good. But after a couple of hours, I noticed that it almost disappeared. My old lashes were straight (I curled them) and didn't look like they had anything on them except at the outside corners. Then at the end of the day, my eyes were getting itchy so I washed it off. My eyes kept itching for over 24 hrs. I really wanted this to work!!

First, This product took almost 1 month to arrive. Second, it is considered a lengthening mascara. The brush is skimpy and does not apply the mascara evenly. I had to use another lash brush to un-clump my eyelashes. One positive is that it came off with a tissue with no effort. Overall, not worth the wait for the quality of the product.

This piece of junk was not worth the amount of money I paid for it. It clumps perfectly, however, if that's what you're looking for in eye lash looks. Just cause it has a name I'd heard of, I thought it would be good. It's not. It's as bad as the very first mascara that came with a little brush. Gross

I purchased this Almay mascara because it is a good product and read that Almay was not tested on animals. After further investigation I found out that Almay's parent company is Revlon which is not cruelty free. I cannot knowingly purchase products that has tortured innocent animals in the process.

Terrible flaking. This is horrible for anyone with any allergies or sensitivities at all. Used it once, horrible reaction thought maybe it was a fluke. Tried again, But within an hour my eyes were covered with black flakes. Had to take it off at work and flush with saline.

I heard a great review on The Today Show for this mascara and was hoping it was true.  It wasn't!  It goes on smooth and lashes do look longer and thicker, but a few hours later there are so many flakes under your eyes, it just plain embarrassing!

I like that it doesn't irritate my eyes but that's about the only thing I like about it. It's very hard to reapply if you want more dramatic lashes it just comes out very clumpy. Takes a while to dry and smears very easily when wet.
Usually love Almay products. This mascara not so much. Very clumpy! Have to wipe the wand off with a tissue to remove excess before using. Otherwise my lashes are just a clumpy mess. Sorry Almay!

claims.text: Many reviewers say this mascara does not irritate their sensitive or dry eyes, making it a good option for those with eye sensitivity.
Reviewers report that it lengthens and lifts lashes effectively, often needing only one or two coats.
Several reviewers complain about clumping and excess product on the wand, with some saying it dries out quickly or ends up under the eyes.
Some reviewers find it easy to apply and long-lasting once set.
